services.value: Nova Biologicals provides microbiological testing services including water testing (USP water testing, commercial water testing, and Legionella pneumophila testing), medical device testing (sterility testing, environmental monitoring, bioburden testing, endotoxin, GLP studies), pharmaceutical testing (microbial testing services for compound pharmaceuticals and USP testing of excipients), and antimicrobial testing (evaluating effectiveness against bacteria, molds, and related assays).
